title: Normalized level definition (legacy levels domain)
description: Contract for one normalized level: one stored legacy levels entry in positional XP-curve order. Levels carry no stable stored id (the legacy loader indexes positionally), so legacy_id is the 0-based positional index as a string (rule T4); all native fields are kept verbatim, including any curve irregularities (rule T3). See packages/game-content/README.md for the rule set and survey citations.

legacy_id.description: Positional index of the stored levels entry as a decimal string (rule T4): levels have no stable stored id and the legacy loader (get_game_config.py) indexes the array positionally.

kind.description: Classification of the stored levels domain: every levels entry maps to level.

source_file.description: Origin file of the stored entry: config/main.json (no patch targets levels).

source_layer.description: Layering origin: stored (no patch targets levels).

content_version.description: Content fingerprint (sha256 over the stored source bytes plus the mods list); sources carry no version stamp.

level_index.description: 0-based position of the entry in the stored levels array; the XP curve order is positional and preserved (rule T4).

name.description: Level rank name, preserved verbatim (rule T3).

exp_required.description: Native stored XP threshold, kept verbatim including any curve irregularities; never smoothed (rule T3).

reward_type.description: Native stored level-up reward resource code, preserved verbatim as an opaque code (rule T3).

reward_amount.description: Native stored level-up reward amount, kept verbatim (rule T3).
